central_reading: Nanavira is best treated as a third position in the reflexivity debate: neither Abhinavagupta's intrinsic self-manifesting subject nor Dharmakirti's no-self reduction, but a structural account where identity, time, and reflexion are generated by difference, transformation, invariance, and level-relative hierarchy.

nnexpr_mappings.quoted_anchor: Two things define a thing, namely the difference between them.

nyaya_reading.hetu: difference is required to distinguish two things
nyaya_reading.sadhya: identity is structurally determined by contrast
nyaya_reading.vyapti: Where there is determinate identity, there is contrastive difference.

nnexpr_mappings.falsifier: Find a determinate identity that is intelligible without any contrast, exclusion, boundary, or relation to another term.
nnexpr_mappings.posterior_policy: May update only the phenomenological/argumentative dimension for the Nanavira candidate; does not directly settle consciousness-fundamental branches.

nnexpr_mappings.quoted_anchor: difference between two things is seen to be an operation

nyaya_reading.hetu: difference is what must be done to pass from one term to another
nyaya_reading.vyapti: Where contrast is generated by transformation/interchange, difference should be modeled relationally rather than as an intrinsic isolated property.

nnexpr_mappings.falsifier: Give a case where the difference between two terms is fully specified without any relation, operation, transformation, or interchange condition.

nnexpr_mappings.quoted_anchor: Duration and Invariance under Transformation are one and the same.

nyaya_reading.sadhya: enduring identity is invariance under transformation
nyaya_reading.vyapti: Where a thing endures through change, the stable identity is the invariant structure across the transformation.

nnexpr_mappings.falsifier: Show duration without any invariant across transformation, or show invariance under transformation that cannot count as duration even within a level.

nnexpr_mappings.quoted_anchor: The structure of structure has the structure of structure.

nyaya_reading.hetu: higher-order reflexion repeats the same structural form as immediate presentation
nyaya_reading.sadhya: reflexivity can be modeled structurally without adding a second substance
nyaya_reading.vyapti: Where reflexion preserves the structure of what is reflected, no hidden owner-substance is required merely to explain recurrence.

nnexpr_mappings.falsifier: Show that higher-order reflexion necessarily changes the structure it reflects or necessarily introduces an owner-substance.

nnexpr_mappings.quoted_anchor: Past and future exist in the present as past and as future.

nyaya_reading.hetu: the general/particular hierarchy is interchangeable with the past/present/future hierarchy
nyaya_reading.sadhya: temporal structure is internally present as differentiated determination
nyaya_reading.vyapti: Where temporal relations are generated by hierarchy, past and future can be present as past and future without existing as external regions.

fallacies_flagged.reason: The hierarchy-to-time vyapti is not invariant across all models of temporal experience.

nnexpr_mappings.falsifier: Provide a coherent temporal model where past/future reference is generated without Nanavira's general/particular hierarchy.

nnexpr_mappings.quoted_anchor: A thing is eternal at its own level.

nyaya_reading.hetu: absolute difference between changing and unchanging is required for duration at a level
nyaya_reading.sadhya: eternity is level-relative rather than absolute substancehood
nyaya_reading.vyapti: Where duration is bounded by a level, eternality is an avacchedaka-scoped claim rather than an unbounded substance claim.

nnexpr_mappings.falsifier: Show that level-relative endurance entails absolute metaphysical eternity, or show a level at which the duration claim has no limiting condition.

nyaya_reading.hetu: both accounts use difference/exclusion to explain determination without substance
nyaya_reading.sadhya: Nanavira difference and Dharmakirti apoha overlap structurally
nyaya_reading.vyapti: Where two accounts use exclusion/difference for determination, they may share a bridge node if their direction of explanation and ontological commitments match.

fallacies_flagged.reason: Apoha is a semantic/cognitive exclusion theory; Nanavira's difference is a structural phenomenological operation. Similarity is not identity.

nnexpr_mappings.falsifier: Show a Dharmakirti apoha use case where exclusion determines meaning but does not imply Nanavira-style transformation, or a Nanavira structural difference use case with no semantic exclusion role.

argument_edges.rationale: If identity is contrast-structured, no-self attacks only owner-substance, not reflexive structure.
Invariance under transformation gives the candidate a non-substance account of persistence and recognition.
A recursive structural account weakens the inference from recognition to intrinsic self-manifestation, but does not explain manifestness itself.
Level-scoping blocks the move from local reflexive structure to unbounded metaphysical consciousness.
The temporal claim supports internal structural locality, but it is capped because the hierarchy-to-time vyapti is contested.
Both accounts use non-substance determination by difference/exclusion, but the bridge is analogical until formal probes establish implication or shared type.

structural_correspondences.important_difference: Nanavira's account is structural/phenomenological; Dharmakirti's apoha is primarily semantic/cognitive. Treating them as identical would overclaim.
structural_correspondences.confidence_language: analogical until formal probes and negative controls pass

directional_critique_pairs.reveals_about_target: Pressed but not defeated. Nanavira attacks the inference from local reflexivity to universal intrinsic self-manifestation, but does not yet explain manifestness without residue.
directional_critique_pairs.target_response_required: Show why local structural reflexivity entails intrinsic universal self-manifestation rather than merely a finite structure.

directional_critique_pairs.reveals_about_target: Structural reflexivity may describe the form of experience while presupposing manifestness rather than explaining it.
directional_critique_pairs.target_response_required: Explain appearing/self-presence without importing intrinsic manifestness as an unstated premise.

directional_critique_pairs.reveals_about_target: Potentially supported by overlap around non-substance determination, but the bridge to apoha remains analogical and capped until formal probes pass.
directional_critique_pairs.target_response_required: Show whether semantic exclusion entails Nanavira-style transformation or only overlaps with it.

bridge_probe_logic.problem: Lexical similarity between difference and apoha must not merge nodes. The engine needs a proof-sensitive bridge check.

candidate_pair.risk: Nanavira's account is structural/phenomenological; Dharmakirti's apoha is primarily semantic/cognitive. Treating them as identical would overclaim.

merge_policy: Do not merge on embedding similarity, shared keywords, or LLM judgment alone.
Create a BRIDGES edge if bidirectional implication is proved under declared bridge axioms and negative bridge controls pass.
Create a SUBSUMES edge if only one implication is proved.
Create a CONTRADICTS edge if one side implies the negation of a core commitment of the other.
Create an OVERLAPS edge if the nodes share primitives but no implication is proved.
Create a DIFFERENT edge if negative controls show the similarity is only verbal.

formal_tests.rationale: Prevents semantic exclusion from being silently inflated into transformation metaphysics.

criticism_defeats_candidate_when: The attack targets a hard-to-vary core commitment, not an auxiliary wording.
The attack itself passes the Nyaya gate or formal proof gate.
The candidate has no surviving reformulation that preserves its explanatory role.
No undercutter defeats the criticism's hetu or vyapti.
The attack removes the candidate's ability to answer the question better than live rivals.

formal_status_to_argument_status.argument_effect: Commitment or bridge may support/attack with full formal dimension weight, while still keeping tradition assumptions visible.
If the refuted node is a hard-to-vary core, mark the candidate defeated unless a narrower replacement core is declared and gated.
Mark the claim non-updating and weaken any candidate that depends on it as a core. Do not defeat the candidate if a more precise reformulation is available.
Record a boundary-as-finding. No formal posterior update; non-formal dimensions can still carry the claim if falsifiers and provenance are explicit.
No defeat and no proof bonus. Keep as live/pending with the gate outcome controlling whether evidence tracking can update.
Split the node: proved subclaim gets formal support, unproved remainder remains open.
